headline: Weathered Expanse Heaviest; Palantine Berm Contested Three Ways
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse continues to carry the war's heaviest traffic, seventy-three events in the past day and five in the last two hours about Wightwalk and Frostmarch, where the lone Colonial work reported in the previous edition has passed to Warden hands; the hex now stands seven Warden, none Colonial and two unclaimed. Mooring County, ten Warden works against two Colonial three hours ago, is now held entire by the Wardens, twelve to none, though activity there has fallen quiet in the past two hours. Palantine Berm is the fresh flashpoint: seven events in two hours and sixteen in the day, with repeated changes about The Pippeli Stones and the ground standing three Warden, three Colonial and one unclaimed. Kuura Strand, which erupted in the earlier edition, has gone silent since late afternoon. Nevish Line reports three events at Grief Mother as casualties run above twelve hundred an hour on both sides. Linn Mercy remains the costliest ground, better than two thousand Warden and fourteen hundred Colonial casualties an hour, though few works have changed hands. Thirty-four towns remain the mark for victory.
